derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic calendar classification over compiled period end dates; no purpose policy.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over monitoring_period; every compiled period receives an in_fy2025 boolean.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical FY2025 scope filter; membership is independent of analytical purpose.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over compiled_dmr_measurement joined to FY2025 periods.
derivations.required_premise: Monitoring period end date within FY2025 window.
derivations.optional_enrichment: period_in_fy2025 may be used equivalently to inline date predicate.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic form classifier for Purpose A routing; treats blank numeric storage (0.0) and NODI-coded rows as non-ordinary per P2 limitation.
derivations.required_premise: Ordinary numeric when nodi_code is empty, reported_value_number is non-zero, and reported_unit_code is present.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: non-ordinary measurement form routes tuple to Purpose C rather than Purpose A exceedance path

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Date-overlap join on shared facility; inclusive effective-window test against period end date.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over compiled_limit_value cross monitoring_period on facility.
derivations.required_premise: period_end_date between limit_begin_date and limit_end_date inclusive.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: per-month seasonal activation is not modeled; all_months_active is not consulted in this derivation

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Exhaustive mechanical pairing of in-scope measurements with schedule limits sharing facility, feature, parameter, and period overlap.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over dmr_in_fy2025_scope cross limit_active_in_period on shared keys.
derivations.required_premise: FY2025 measurement and period-overlapping limit on matching facility/feature/parameter.
derivations.optional_enrichment: dmr_in_fy2025_scope and limit_active_in_period provide equivalent pre-filtered inputs.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: multiple candidates are expected and resolved downstream by limit_applicability_resolution

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Schedule effective-window overlap with FY2025; no conditional activation evaluation.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over monitoring_requirement_schedule rows whose effective dates intersect FY2025.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: conditional permit-text triggers are not evaluated here; deferred to monitoring_obligation_resolution

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Pairs FY2025 non-ordinary DMR submissions with overlapping schedule requirements; excludes ordinary-numeric tuples routed to Purpose A.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE: absent-submission cases are not enumerable because frequency-code interpretation rules are not compiled as world facts (01_vocabulary.json limitation).
derivations.required_premise: FY2025 DMR row with nodi_code present or reported_value_number = 0.0, joined to overlapping monitoring_requirement_schedule tuple.
derivations.optional_enrichment: measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_result = false provides equivalent non-ordinary filter.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: absent expected submissions without a located DMR row are omitted from the universe

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects Purpose A rows for FY2025 ordinary-numeric measurements with admitted limit_applicability_resolution and limit_kind_resolution from 05_dispositions.json; computes exceedance inline because exceedance_resolution was not adjudicated.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Rows cover all dmr_in_fy2025_scope measurements with has_ordinary_numeric = true; each appears in rows or unresolved. Non-ordinary measurements are out of scope for Purpose A.
derivations.required_premise: Admitted limit_applicability_resolution disposition per in-scope measurement; when ACCEPT, admitted limit_kind_resolution for the selected limit; compiled numeric measurement and limit threshold for exceedance when limit_category is enforceable_numeric.
derivations.optional_enrichment: measurement_limit_candidate_pair supports grounding receipts; source CSV paths cited in disposition grounding packets.
blocking_unresolved_state: limit_applicability_resolution UNRESOLVED blocks a definitive applicability verdict and routes the measurement to purpose_ir/a/output.json unresolved
limit_kind_resolution UNRESOLVED on the selected limit blocks enforceable-numeric classification and exceedance determination
non_blocking_unresolved_state: limit_kind_resolution REJECT as report_only or no_numeric_comparison still emits a row with limit_applicability_status no_enforceable_numeric_limit_applies and exceedance comparison_not_applicable
exceedance unresolved on an otherwise established enforceable limit still emits a row with exceedance = unresolved

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects Purpose B rows from admitted monitoring_obligation_resolution dispositions; verdict required/not_required/unresolved is taken from C3 packets, not inferred from missing DMR rows.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every monitoring_requirement_in_fy2025 referent is evaluated exactly once for applicability_context FY2025 overlap 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30.
derivations.optional_enrichment: source_document_anchor and permit PDF text are not required for unconditional schedule rows; condition_anchor_text from schedule enriches condition_dependencies labeling only.
blocking_unresolved_state: monitoring_obligation_resolution UNRESOLVED blocks a required/not_required verdict and routes the requirement to purpose_ir/b/output.json unresolved
non_blocking_unresolved_state: permit-text condition evaluation gaps are recorded as unresolved without defaulting to not_required

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects Purpose C semantic classification from admitted missing_evidence_resolution; defers when linked monitoring_obligation_resolution remains unresolved.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE universe: only located non-ordinary FY2025 DMR cases in missing_evidence_case_universe; absent-submission expectations omitted.
derivations.required_premise: Admitted missing_evidence_resolution per case in missing_evidence_case_universe.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Cross-reference to monitoring_obligation_resolution verdict when obligation status gates classification; NODI and qualifier fields from compiled_dmr_measurement for observed_result_form.
blocking_unresolved_state: missing_evidence_resolution UNRESOLVED routes case to purpose_ir/c/output.json unresolved
linked monitoring_obligation_resolution UNRESOLVED blocks positive established_state classification per Purpose C deferral policy
non_blocking_unresolved_state: mere absence of numeric result alone never yields a compliance or violation classification

semantic_inputs_not_in_world.note: Admitted PURPOSE resolutions are consumed by derive_purposes.py but not materialized in world.sqlite per 06_admission.json.

limitations: exceedance_resolution was not adjudicated in 05_dispositions.json; exceedance is computed inline in derive_purposes.py only when limit_kind is enforceable_numeric.
missing_evidence_case_universe is INCOMPLETE for absent-submission cases.
Per-month seasonal activation for limits is not modeled; limit_applicability UNRESOLVED may reflect schedule underdetermination.
Permit PDF text extraction is deferred; monitoring_obligation_resolution with condition_anchor_text often remains UNRESOLVED.
All 209 admitted missing_evidence_resolution dispositions are UNRESOLVED in the current workspace; purpose_ir/c/output.json rows is empty.
